verdict.rationale: Access-restricted sub-teams are a fair question for a team collaboration tool like Trello, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about private teams, sub-teams, private boards or workspaces, or restricting membership to specific people. Mentions of Workspaces for Power-Up registration and of adding people to cards are adjacent features and do not show restricted sub-teams.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create private sub-teams restricted to specific members
